irving.definition:
n. United States writer remembered for his stories (1783-1859)
n. United States writer of darkly humorous novels (born in 1942)
irving.translation: n. 欧文（男子名, 涵义为海的朋友）；欧文（美国作家）

irving langmuir.translation: [网络] 朗缪尔；欧文·兰米尔；欧文朗缪尔

irving's method.translation: [医] 欧文氏法(枕后位旋转法)

irvingia.translation: [网络] 大叶欧文粘木；文嘉木；非洲芒果

irvingia gabonensis.translation: [网络] 野生芒果；非洲芒果；提取精华

irvingite.definition:
n. The common designation of one a sect founded by the Rev.
   Edward Irving (about 1830), who call themselves the Catholic Apostolic
   Church. They are highly ritualistic in worship, have an elaborate
   hierarchy of apostles, prophets, etc., and look for the speedy coming
   of Christ.
irvingite.translation: n. [宗]使徒公教会信徒( 自称伊尔文派信徒)
